descriptionChirho: A masculine proper noun referring to the Levitical figure Shelomoth (שְׁלֹמוֹת), appearing in genealogical and administrative lists in Chronicles. S141429 (4 occ) gives the base form (eng 'Shelomot', spa 'Shelomot', hin शलोमोत, arb شْلُومُوتُ, kor 쉐로못, swa 'Shelomothi') and S141432 (1 occ) is the same name with conjunction waw (spa 'y Selomot', hin और शलोमोत, arb وَشْلُومُوت, swa 'na Shelomothi'). Both refer to the same individual(s) bearing the name Shelomoth in Levitical genealogies.

A proper noun representing the name Shelomith (שְׁלֹמִית), a feminine or variant form distinct from Shelomoth. The translational evidence shows the gender-marked difference: eng 'Shelomit', spa 'Selomit', hin शलोमीत, arb شْلُومِيت (note the kasra vowel indicating the -it ending), kor 쉐로미드/솔로밋, swa 'Shelomithi'. This form with the feminine -it suffix points to either a different individual or a distinct onomastic tradition within the Chronicler's genealogies.
